title: Accelerator acquisition tactical logbook
content:
Purpose: running log for short-to-mid runway decisions on accelerator acquisitions (heterogeneous SKU mix), order cadence experiments, and cross-region fulfillment fallbacks. This is intentionally tactical — contains heuristics, one-off calculations, and questions for vendor ops.

Background/context:
- Q1–Q2 2025 shape: traffic growth + new dedicated customer commitments predicted to increase token-hour consumption by ~38–45% across west/us and eu-west. We need ~6–8% extra peak capacity buffer beyond committed to avoid SLA penalties during rollouts.
- Current fleet snapshot (rough at time of notes): A100-80GB: 420 units; H100-PCIe: 180 units; L4 (inference) equivalents: 240 units. Average utilization (30d rolling): west/us 74% peak, eu-west 68% peak, apac small pool 55%.

Today's goals:
1) Define candidate order tranches for May/Jun that smooth lead-time exposure.
2) Pick a conservative SKU mix to buy for immediate commit vs. opportunistic short-leases.
3) Set hard triggers for breaking a tranche (vendor delay > 14 days, customs > baseline).

Quick heuristics we are using:
- Reorder point (units) = (expected daily consumption * lead_time_days) + safety_stock.
- Safety stock = z * sigma_d * sqrt(lead_time_days) where z=1.28 (~90% service). We use z=1.28 for committed capacity, z=0.84 (~80%) for opportunistic orders.
- Expected daily consumption estimate derived from token-hour -> GPU-hour mapping (back-of-envelope): 1 H100 ~ 3.2 A100-equivalent inference capacity for our workload mix.

Example calculation for west/us A100-equivalent demand (simplified):
- Projected incremental demand (next 90d) = 12,000 GPU-hours/day (A100-equivalent).
- Planned lead time for vendor tranche A = 45 days median (vendor quoting).
- sigma_d (daily demand stdev) = 1,800 GPU-hours (measured).
- Reorder point = 12,000 * 45 + 1.28 * 1,800 * sqrt(45) = 540,000 + 1.28*1,800*6.708 = 540,000 + 15,480 ≈ 555,480 GPU-hours -> convert to units depending on SKU.
- If buying H100s, divide by 3.2 -> ~173 units. If buying A100-80GB -> ~555,480 / (24*24?) Note: need per-unit GPU-hour estimate per day (operational hours). Assume 24h operation, per-day capacity per unit = 24 GPU-hours. So units = 555,480 / 24 ≈ 23,145 (!) obviously this demonstrates an error in unit mapping; re-evaluate with GPU-hours/day per cluster vs per unit. TODO: get clean per-unit hours mapping from telemetry. (notes to self: sync with SRE telemetry exports ENG-SPL-56)

Ordering cadence options (candidate tranches):
- Tranche Alpha (conservative): 40% of delta demand, ordered as reserved PO with 50–60 day lead-time window. Aim: coverage for core dedicated customers.
- Tranche Beta (fast-turn): 30% of delta, short lease / brokerage (6–14d availability), higher $/hour but minimizes variant lock.
- Tranche Gamma (opportunistic): 30% of delta, spot/resale/long-lead opportunistic buys negotiated with vendor credits. Tranche Gamma includes conditional cancel or delayed delivery with vendor escrow.

Vendor lead-time notes from ops:
- Vendor A (direct OEM channel): quoted 42–58 days typical, customs variance +10–14 days E2E for eu-west.
- Vendor B (channel partner, lease broker): 7–18 days but limited contiguous bulk (>50 units) availability windows. Premium ~18–27%.
- Vendor C (secondary refurb/used): 21–35 days shipping plus rebuild; cheaper but higher failure rate (2–4% DOA historically).

Risk triggers (operational):
- If Vendor A median slips > +8 days on two consecutive shipments -> move 20% of remaining Alpha tranche to Beta.
- If customs delays > baseline +12 days in eu-west -> accelerate cross-region swaps and prioritize short leases to eu-west.
- If DOA rate on secondary > 3% in a tranche -> terminate future buys with Vendor C and rotate to broker.

Cross-region swap lanes (fast-fallback play):
- Warm lanes: keep 10% of Beta lease capacity in a geographically flexible pool (can be reallocated within 72h).
- Hard rules: no more than 1 dedicated-customer mingle per 24h reassign to avoid SLA churn.

Short checklist before committing PO:
- Confirm PO net-30 vs net-60 impact on cash runway (finance check: @Lina).
- Get acceptance criteria doc: burn-in (72h), perf test (end-to-end t95 latency < baseline + 12%), KV cache warm time measurement.
- Create GH issue to hook infra acceptance automation (repo: infra/acceptance-scripts).

Open questions / TODOs:
- Need clear per-unit GPU-hour README from telemetry; current numbers mixed units. Action: request daily per-unit effective GPU-hours by SKU from SRE (owner: Ethan).
- Decide fallback budget for Beta tranche (how much ops can tolerate premium). Finance limit: up to 14% above baseline for short-term leases without exec sign-off.
- Confirm customs baseline with logistics partner (Vendor A logistics rep).

Snapshot decision (working):
- Lock Alpha at 35% of predicted increment (smaller than original 40%) to reduce exposure.
- Buy Beta leases to cover 45% of increment (more emphasis on short-term agility).
- Reserve Gamma for opportunistic buys up to 20% depending on vendor credits availability.

Notes to hand off to vendor-ops sync (tomorrow):
1) Ask Vendor A to commit to weekly milestone updates with lead-time drift flag.
2) Ask Broker (Vendor B) for contiguous block schedule; request hold-back clause for 10% cancel with 14d notice.
3) Request Vendor C test sample batch of 10 refurb units to validate DOA assumption before full tranche.

Snippet: rough table for internal ops (plaintext)
| Tranche | % of delta | Lead time (days) | Cost premium | Primary vendor | Contingency |
| Alpha   | 35%        | 50–60            | +0% baseline  | Vendor A       | shift to Beta if +8d drift |
| Beta    | 45%        | 7–18             | +18–27%       | Vendor B       | keep 10% warm pool          |
| Gamma   | 20%        | 21–35            | -15% (used)   | Vendor C       | stop if DOA >3%             |

Meeting anchors:
- Vendor sync (internal): Thu 09:00 PT (agenda: tranche commitments, customs baseline, QA sample plan).
- Finance review: Fri 14:00 PT (decision: alpha % locked and payment terms).

Notes-style ops tasks (fast):
- [ ] Create PO template for Alpha with clear milestone-triggered payments (owner: Maya).
- [ ] Add telemetry request ticket for per-unit GPU-hours (owner: Ethan).
- [ ] Draft acceptance checklist and share with SRE (owner: Arjun).
- [ ] Slack #vendor-ops: paste contingency rules and ask for vendor A contact info (owner: Maya).

Historical lessons (short):
- Last cycle (Nov 2024): over-committed to long-lead A100 tranche -> had to lease Beta with 25% premium for three weeks. Avoid repeating; prefer smaller locked alpha + more Beta.
- Customs in Germany had a one-off 18d extra delay Dec 2024 due to paperwork mismatch; ensure vendor pre-clear documentation list is checked.

Appendix: quick glossary for this doc:
- Beta pool: short-leases / brokered capacity for fast response.
- Alpha: reserved direct buys with predictable price but longer lead-time.
- Gamma: opportunistic/used/refurb buys.

End notes: this logbook will be updated after vendor sync. Keep rough numbers here until telemetry owner publishes canonical per-SKU throughput table. Use this doc as the canonical tactical decisions record for the May procurement window.

-- Maya
